decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory that supports the core trailer business and after-sales offering, it is useful to keep even if it is not strategically central.
A box trailer series is a core product for a German trailer maker and its home-page prominence suggests it fits broad customer demand well.
The car transporter line is somewhat more niche and investment-heavy, but it still matches the firm's transport focus and professional customer base.
Low-bed trailers are a strong fit with varied hauling tasks and likely support the firm's reputation for reliable, practical transport solutions.
High trailer covers are a natural add-on across multiple trailer models, so they strengthen cross-selling with limited additional resource needs.
Because it appears to overlap directly with another box trailer series, portfolio simplification is the most likely management choice to avoid duplication and free resources.
